definitions.aggregation: Original equal-weight independent-process aggregates; p50/p95/p99 are means of three process percentiles, never pooled percentiles.
definitions.changes: Original after_minus_before means OFF minus ON; before_minus_direct means ON minus direct Rust; after_minus_direct means OFF minus direct Rust. Percent uses the subtracted reference as denominator.
definitions.latency: Scheduled arrival to successful completion, including queue/IPC. Original A21 decisions apply to arrival means, not p99.
definitions.rates: Per-scenario rates contribute to the whole mixed process window; exact elapsed denominators are retained.
definitions.resources: Whole-profile only. CPU is percent of one core. RSS is sampled. An aggregate mean of process peaks is distinct from its maximum process peak.
definitions.allocation: Partial sampled GC.GetTotalAllocatedBytes(false) bracket; not exact allocation per call. Managed GC is N/A for direct Rust; native allocation/copy/FFI counts unavailable.
definitions.bytes: Payload and protobuf encoded bytes are separate; protobuf counts exclude gRPC envelope, HTTP/2 and TLS.
definitions.overlap: Maximum in-progress client calls is not an exact active HTTP/2 stream counter.
definitions.scope: No capacity, long-duration credit, final selection or retention approval follows from fixed-load validity.
